module: MCP vehicle telemetry tools: electrics values (RPM, speed, gear, fuel…), damage summary, and a global GE-side state snapshot.
notes: get_electrics is asynchronous (vehicle VM -> `_cb.electrics` callback -> shared.asyncResults.electrics): the call returns the result of the previous request.
Without `keys`, only the scalar values (number, string, boolean) of electrics.values are returned.
get_status does not include rpm/gear/AI (vehicle VM): use get_electrics and get_ai.

cb.desc: Callback `electrics(vid, json)`: stores the JSON in shared.asyncResults.electrics.

returns.desc: true if the vehicle does not exist.
true if the vehicle does not exist.

get_status.desc: Snapshot: sim {physicsRunning, timeScale}, vehicleCount, level, camera {mode, pos}, player vehicle {id, jbeam, configKey, pos, speed (m/s), damage}.
